card.name: Small words inside list items and clauses
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'to', 'of', 'has' or 'fail' that sit just before a verb or noun in general prose. Seen in numbered lists, policy and history writing.

modes.label: List item 'to'
modes.description: The word 'to' opening a numbered rule or step.
modes.example: (4)<< to>> make sure nothing is left out.

modes.label: Verb of failing or delay
modes.description: A verb or auxiliary about a state failing or being slow, in policy text.
modes.example: often ignore its guidelines or<< fail>> to coordinate policies

modes.label: 'of' after a noun
modes.description: The word 'of' after a noun in a title or a phrase like 'habits of'.
modes.example: his habits<< of>> observation and his powers of reasoning

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in ordinary essay and policy prose, not on medical content.
